record: Rule-6 mutants for the polaris-dossier S11 slice (syzygy-qkea.12): the /polaris-dossier skill, the Codex instructions and their lint, aligned to version 1.1 of the change (REQ-polaris-generation-033; D9-N5, N1 and N6 as signed; R3-F9). Text mutants: a granting sentence (T1), the agent told to run allow-execution (T2), a public-only description (T3), an unknown option (T4), a required option dropped (T6), no deferral to the brief (T5), deferral to the authoring brief alone (T7), the choice reused across runs (T8), no working directory for reported commands (T9), no scope statement (T10), no generous-deadline advice (T11), no close-before-deadline instruction (T12), the trigger phrase dropped from the description (T13). Lint mutants: the negation class matching everything (L1), required options unchecked (L2), positional words unchecked (L3), the public check off (L4), the N5 quotation paraphrased so the spec bytes no longer carry it (L5), the trigger check vacuous (L6), the deferral check accepting any brief (L7). Not authority.
method: Each mutant replaces `old` with `new` (exactly one occurrence) in one file of the S11 worktree at `commit`, runs `command` from the worktree root, then restores the file; the tree was clean after the run. A mutant is killed only when the replacement applied and the command exits nonzero. The spec file is a subject, read by the lint, and never mutated.
